products.title: Sage Green DAL Cap
products.body_html: Laidback but still sharp. This unstructured cap comes in a natural canvas crown with a green bill, topped off with raised DAL embroidery up front. Lightweight, easy to wear, and broken-in from day one—this one’s built for the course, the city, and everything in between.

products.title: Nylon Golfer
products.body_html: Stay cool and comfortable with the Nylon Golfer, a lightweight hat designed for active days. Featuring breathable mesh paneling in the front, this hat keeps you ventilated while the semi-structured shape gives it a boxy shape. The Kingfisher logo is embroidered on the front, and the adjustable strap back ensures a secure, customizable fit for any head size. Perfect for golf, outdoor activities, or casual wear.
